levels.surface: أحمد بن محمد بن يحيى العطار
إبراهيم بن محمد بن عبد الله

notes: Two sayings with two isnads (rule 4a): the birth account by Naseem and Mariya, and the sneeze account in which Ibrahim continues the chain to Naseem and then the Imam.
In the birth account the Imam speaks inside the women's story, so he is the last link (owner ruling 5).
خادم أبي محمد describes Naseem and is not a link; the father's name is only a place reference.
